blocks.title: Digital entrepreneurship
blocks.text: Digital entrepreneurship technology aur online platforms ke zariye business ke khayalat banana, chalana aur barhana hai.

Digital entrepreneurship ka matlab hai technology aur online platforms ke zariye business ke khayalat banana, chalana aur barhana. Yeh logon ko innovative (naye andaz ke) digital hal se asal zindagi ke masle hal karne mein madad deti hai. Entrepreneurs (karobar shuru karne wale) duniya bhar ke customers tak pohanchne ke liye social media, e-commerce websites aur freelancing platforms use karte hain. Innovation (jiddat) badalti market ki zarooratein poori karne wale naye products aur services banane mein aham kirdar ada karti hai. Yeh shoba talaba ko mauqa deta hai ke apne takhleeqi khayalat ko kamyab digital karobar mein badlein.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Zyada tar kamyab entrepreneurs paidaishi risk lene wale nahi hote; woh tajurbe se risk lene ki salahiyat seekhte hain.
Kamyab entrepreneurs ki khoobiyan

Kamyab entrepreneurs creative hote hain aur masle hal karne ke liye hamesha naye khayalat dhoondte rehte hain. Woh mehnati hote hain aur apne maqsad hasil karne ke liye pakke rehte hain. Achhe entrepreneurs pur-aitmad hote hain aur soch samajh kar (calculated) risk lene ko tayyar hote hain. Un mein faisla karne aur masle hal karne ki mazboot salahiyat hoti hai. Woh lachakdar (adaptable) bhi hote hain aur market ke badalte halaat aur customers ki zarooraton ke mutabiq dhal jate hain.
Pakistan mein entrepreneurship aur digital economy

Internet aur mobile technology tak barhti rasai ki wajah se Pakistan mein entrepreneurship tezi se barh rahi hai. Bohat se naujawan social media, e-commerce platforms aur freelancing websites ke zariye online karobar shuru kar rahe hain. Digital economy (digital maeeshat) software development, digital marketing aur online services jaise shobon mein rozgar ke naye mauqe paida kar rahi hai. Hukoomat aur private idare bhi startups aur innovation ki madad kar rahe hain. Yeh taraqqi mulk ki maeeshat behtar kar rahi hai aur naujawanon ko naukri dhoondne ki bajaye naukriyan dene wala banne par aamada kar rahi hai.
Business ke mauqe pehchanna

Business ke mauqe pehchanne ka matlab hai muashre ke aise masle dhoondna jo products ya services se hal ho sakein. Entrepreneurs customers ki zarooratein aur market ki demand samajhne ke liye rozmarra zindagi ko ghaur se dekhte hain. Technology naye mauqe dhoondne mein madad deti hai, jaise online taleem, e-commerce aur digital services. Kamyab entrepreneurs asal zindagi ke masle naye tareeqon se hal karne par focus karte hain. Pakistan mein zaraat (agriculture), sehat (healthcare) aur taleem jaise shobe digital business ke khayalat ke liye bohat mauqe dete hain.

blocks.alt: Darakht numa khaaka (tree diagram). Upar ka dabba Technology-Based Solutions teeron se chaar dabbon tak jata hai: Education (E-learning), Healthcare (Telemedicine), Agriculture (Smart farming) aur Business (Digital payments).
blocks.caption: Figure 9.4: Technology par mabni hal (technology-based solutions) (kitab ki Figure 9.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki tasveer mein Business ka dabba Healthcare ke neeche latka hai aur teer Healthcare se Business ki taraf hai, jaise karobar sehat ka hissa ho. Kitab ka apna matn chaar alag shobe batata hai: taleem, sehat, zaraat (agriculture) aur karobar. Is liye yahan Business ko baqi teen ki tarah seedha upar wale dabbe ki chauthi shaakh banaya gaya hai. Har shobe ke saath bracket mein us ki technology ki misal hai.
Technology se asal zindagi ke masle hal karna

Technology entrepreneurs ko asal zindagi ke masle tez aur behtar tareeqe se hal karne mein madad deti hai. Yeh logon ko taleem, sehat, zaraat aur karobar ke challenges ke liye digital hal banane deti hai (Figure 9.4 dekhein). Misal: online learning platforms talaba ko ghar se parhne dete hain, aur mobile apps kisanon ko fasal ki paidawar behtar karne mein madad deti hain. Digital payment systems paison ka len-den aasan aur mehfooz banate hain. Technology ko takhleeqi andaz mein use kar ke entrepreneurs aise naye hal bana sakte hain jo logon ki rozmarra zindagi behtar karein.
Market ki zarooratein aur customers ki demand pehchanna

Market ki zarooratein aur customers ki demand pehchanne ka matlab hai samajhna ke log kya chahte hain aur unhein kaun se masle hain. Entrepreneurs behtar products aur services design karne ke liye customers ka rawaiya, pasand aur trends (rujhanat) parhte hain. Surveys, feedback aur online data market mein khali jagah (gaps) dhoondne mein madad dete hain. Customers ki zarooratein achhi tarah poori karna customer ki tasalli aur business ki kamyabi laata hai. Digital economy mein online trends aur users ka feedback parakhna kamyab business khayalat ke liye bohat zaroori hai.
Entrepreneurship ke liye digital platforms

blocks.alt: Darakht numa khaaka. Upar ka dabba Digital Entrepreneurship, us se teen teer neeche: Social Media (Facebook, Instagram), E-commerce (Daraz, Amazon) aur Freelancing (Fiverr, Upwork).
blocks.caption: Figure 9.5: Digital platforms (kitab ki Figure 9.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Business ki promotion ke liye social media ka istemal

Digital platforms entrepreneurs ko online karobar shuru karne, chalane aur barhane ke tools dete hain (yeh Figure 9.5 mein dikhaya gaya hai). In platforms mein social media, e-commerce websites aur freelancing marketplaces shamil hain. Social media products ki promotion (tashheer) aur bohat se logon tak jaldi pohanchne mein madad deta hai. E-commerce platforms physical dukaan ke baghair cheezein khareedne bechne dete hain. Freelancing websites duniya bhar mein apni skills aur services pesh karne ke mauqe deti hain, jis se entrepreneurship aasan aur sab ki pohanch mein ho jati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab digital platforms (social media, e-commerce, freelancing) ke paragraph mein "as shown in Figure 9.4" likhti hai. Lekin Figure 9.4 technology par mabni hal (taleem, sehat, zaraat, karobar) dikhati hai; platforms wali tasveer Figure 9.5 hai, jo upar di gayi hai. Sahi hawala (reference) Figure 9.5 hai.
E-commerce platforms aur online marketplaces

E-commerce platforms aur online marketplaces karobar ko internet par products aur services bechne dete hain. Yeh physical dukaan ki zaroorat ke baghair bechne walon ko customers se milate hain. Yeh platforms khareedna bechna aasan, tez aur zyada logon ki pohanch mein bana dete hain. Misalon mein aisi websites aur apps hain jahan users products dekh sakte, qeematon ka muwazna kar sakte aur online order de sakte hain. Kharche kam kar ke aur market barha kar yeh digital entrepreneurship ki madad mein aham kirdar ada karte hain.
Freelancing aur remote work ke mauqe

Freelancing aur remote work logon ko online platforms ke zariye clients ko apni skills aur services pesh karne dete hain. Freelancers graphic design, writing, programming aur digital marketing jaise shobon mein kaam kar sakte hain. Remote work logon ko ghar se ya internet connection wali kisi bhi jagah se companies ke liye kaam karne deta hai. Yeh mauqe talaba aur professionals ko khud-mukhtar (independent) aamdani kamane mein madad dete hain. Yeh digital entrepreneurship ka aham hissa hain kyunke yeh lachak (flexibility) aur duniya bhar ki job markets tak rasai dete hain.
Chhote digital business ki planning

Chhote digital business ki planning mein khayalat ko ek wazeh aur qabil-e-amal plan mein munazzam karna shamil hai. Entrepreneurs pehle aisa product ya service pehchante hain jo customers ki zaroorat poori kare. Phir woh target audience (kin logon ke liye), qeemat (pricing) aur digital platforms ke zariye delivery ka tareeqa tay karte hain. Kharche aur mutawaqqa aamdani sambhalne ke liye ek basic budget banaya jata hai. Sahi planning yaqeeni banati hai ke business amli, munazzam aur digital market mein kamyabi ke zyada qareeb ho.

blocks.alt: Chaar qadam teeron se jure: 1. Product ya khidmat (gahak ki zaroorat poori kare); 2. Target audience (kin gahakon ke liye); 3. Qeemat aur delivery (digital platforms ke zariye); 4. Basic budget (kharch aur mutawaqqa aamdani).
blocks.caption: Chhote digital karobar ki mansooba bandi ke qadam (is sabaq ke liye hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh tasveer nahi).

blocks.text: Business planning ke bunyadi concepts

Bunyadi business planning mein yeh wazeh goals tay karna shamil hai ke business kya hasil karna chahta hai. Is mein product ya service pehchanna, target market samajhna aur customers tak value (faida) pohanchane ka tareeqa tay karna shamil hai. Entrepreneurs business chalane ke liye darkar wasail, jaise waqt, paisa aur skills, ki bhi planning karte hain. Ek saada business plan khayalat munazzam karta hai aur kamyab digital business shuru karne aur barhane ki simt deta hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Zyada tar nakam startups ke paas wazeh plan nahi hota.
Budgeting aur resource management

Budgeting aur resource management mein yeh planning shamil hai ke business mein paisa, waqt aur doosre wasail kaise use honge. Budget entrepreneurs ko kharchon ka andaza lagane, qeematein tay karne aur aamdani aur kharche achhi tarah sambhalne mein madad deta hai. Sahi resource management yaqeeni banata hai ke materials, skills aur tools zaya kiye baghair achhi tarah use hon. Digital karobar mein achhi budgeting aur resource planning munafa (profit) barqarar rakhti aur lambe arse ki kamyabi mein madad deti hai.
Startups mein teamwork aur communication

Startups aur chhote digital karobar ki kamyabi ke liye teamwork aur communication zaroori hain. Team members mushtarka goals hasil karne ke liye khayalat, zimmedariyan aur skills share kar ke mil kar kaam karte hain. Mo-assar communication ghalat-fehmiyon se bachati hai aur faisle behtar banati hai. Startups mein meetings, messaging apps aur online tools ke zariye wazeh coordination (rabta) kaam ko aasani se chalata hai. Mazboot teamwork aur communication productivity barhate hain aur business ko kamyabi se barhne mein madad dete hain.
Innovation aur mustaqbil ke mauqe

Innovation ka matlab hai naye aur behtar khayalat, products ya services banana jo masle behtar tareeqe se hal karein. Digital entrepreneurship mein innovation karobar ko barhne aur market mein muqable mein rehne mein madad deti hai. Artificial intelligence, mobile apps aur online platforms jaisi technologies ki wajah se mustaqbil ke mauqe tezi se barh rahe hain. Yeh technologies naujawan entrepreneurs ke liye naye career aur business ke khayalat paida kar rahi hain. Innovation apna kar log kamyab aur mustaqbil ke liye tayyar digital karobar bana sakte hain.
Nayi ubharti technologies aur entrepreneurship

Emerging (nayi ubharti) technologies jaise artificial intelligence, cloud computing, blockchain aur mobile applications entrepreneurship ko badal rahi hain. Yeh technologies entrepreneurs ko zyada smart, tez aur behtar business hal banane mein madad deti hain. Yeh kharche kam karti, productivity barhati aur digital platforms ke zariye duniya bhar tak pohanch deti hain. Startups in technologies se aise naye products aur services banate hain jo aaj ke customers ki zarooratein poori karein. Nateeje mein emerging technologies duniya bhar mein digital entrepreneurship ke naye mauqe khol rahi hain.
Business mein AI, apps aur digital services ka kirdar

Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile apps aur digital services jadeed karobar ki taraqqi mein aham kirdar ada karte hain. AI entrepreneurs ko data parakhne, customers ka rawaiya samajhne aur behtar faisle karne mein madad deta hai. Mobile apps karobar ke liye customers tak pohanchna, products bechna aur services jaldi dena aasan banati hain. Online payments, cloud storage aur marketing tools jaisi digital services karkardagi barhati aur kharche kam karti hain. Mil kar yeh technologies innovation ki madad karti hain aur digital economy mein karobar ko zyada muqable ke qabil banati hain.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: AI tools ab design kar sakte, likh sakte aur karobar chalane mein madad bhi kar sakte hain.
Technology entrepreneurship mein career ke raaste

Technology entrepreneurship digital daur mein talaba ke liye career ke kai raaste deti hai. Log apna digital karobar bana kar aur shuru kar ke startup founder (bani) ban sakte hain. Kuch log programming, graphic design aur digital marketing jaise shobon mein freelancer ke taur par kaam kar sakte hain. App development, e-commerce management aur online consultancy (mashwara dene) ke careers bhi tezi se barh rahe hain. Technology ke barhne ke saath talaba innovator bhi ban sakte hain jo asal zindagi ke masail ke liye naye digital hal banayein.
